*Built using Windsurf*

![](/assets/images/29eb3620-ce21-8088-88da-e05578763fe5.png)

Built a **Chrome extension** ([Link](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/resume-pdf-extractor-rela/fljeffmapkjdmioaifehikepmikepgin)) using **Windsurf** to enable seamless resume downloading, cataloging, and retrieval from ISB’s placement preparation portal; unlocking a previously unavailable capability for students to independently download and organize resumes efficiently.
